market.question: Will Synalphimab be FDA-approved for NSCLC by December 31, 2025?
market.resolutionRules: Resolves YES if FDA approves Synalphimab for any NSCLC indication on or before 2025-12-31 ET per Drugs@FDA or an official FDA press announcement. Conditional approval counts as approval. Resolves NO otherwise.

marketQuestion.resolutionDefinition: FDA approval of Synalphimab for any NSCLC indication on or before the deadline; conditional approval counts.
